name: Self Upgrade
description: Learns from Claude CLI releases (user-triggered) and folds notably incremental, documented, revertible improvements into Ghola, then bumps the version and commits and pushes the change.

releaseNotesSource.label: Release Notes Source
releaseNotesSource.description: URL the agent fetches for Claude Code release notes. Falls back to a WebSearch if the URL fails or looks stale.

changeLogPath.label: Upgrade Ledger Path
changeLogPath.description: Repo-relative path to the append-only upgrade ledger, recording the last processed version and one entry (with commit hash) per applied change.

maxChangesPerRun.label: Max Changes Per Run
maxChangesPerRun.description: Cap on upgrades applied per run. Proposals may exceed it; the agent ranks candidates and applies only the top ones, keeping each run small and revertible.

autoApply.label: Auto Apply
autoApply.description: Off (default): agent proposes changes and waits for approval. On: applies changes without a per-change approval gate. Leave off unless unattended application is intended.

requireVerification.label: Require Verification
requireVerification.description: On (default): a change must pass build, typecheck, and QA before commit. Off removes this gate (not recommended). commitAndPush=auto always verifies before pushing regardless of this setting.

commitAndPush.label: Commit and Push
commitAndPush.description: Controls pushing. on-approval (default): asks first. auto: pushes after verification always passes, regardless of Require Verification. off: never pushes. A protected branch (tool.git) is never pushed either way.

versionBump.label: Version Bump
versionBump.description: How VERSION is bumped when self upgrade records a run. patch (default): increments the patch digit. minor: increments the minor digit. manual: leaves the version number to the user instead of auto-incrementing.
